Lievis by Joel Gibson

Website: https://www.jgibson.id.au/lievis/
Repository: https://github.com/joelgibson/lievis

This site's typography, palette, layout and interaction design follow Lievis.
The KaTeX distribution and four body/UI font files were obtained from the local
Lievis source tree. Those third-party files retain their own upstream licences.
Lievis's TypeScript library and Svelte components are not bundled or imported
by this review website.

No explicit licence for Lievis-specific code was found in the local checkout
or the checked repository on 14 November 2026. This attribution is not a grant
of permission. Permission for any adapted Lievis-specific source should be
clarified with Joel Gibson before publication.

The upstream README has not been redistributed in this clean copy because its
redistribution terms were not established.
